headline: Signed a FY26 supplemental pro rata billing warrant and one tax exemption denial notice.
summary: Discussion covered work on the FY28 budget for the Town Manager. The Assessor also reported an extensive records request from Kevin Keenan for commercial and industrial projects from FY22-26. The meeting then moved into executive session to review abatement and exemption applications.
decisions: Approved unanimously the open session and executive session minutes of November 10, 2026.

plain_text:
TOWN OF SUTTON
BOARD OF ASSESSORS
 4 UXBRIDGE ROAD
SUTTON, MA  01590-1702
  508-865-8722
Meeting Minutes – November 17, 2026
Present: Robert Nunnemacher, Chairman
 Tracey Tardy, Principal Assessor
 Matthew Read, Assessor
Meeting called to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.         The Board voted unanimously to accept the open session meeting minutes and executive session
            meeting minutes of November 10, 2026
2.         Old & New Business
The Assessor discussed with the Board the Department Head Meeting held on November 17, 2026
The Assessor advised the Board that she is working on the FY28 Budget for the Town Manager
The Assessor advised the Board she has been working on an extensive records request from Kevin Keenan
for any commercial/industrial projects from FY22-26
3.         Decisions & Actions Taken
The Board signed one (1) State Tax Form 135 – Property Tax Exemption Denial Notice
The Board signed the Warrant for FY26 Supplemental Pro Rata billing to the Tax Collector
and Town Accountant
4.         Adjourned Open Session @ 5:40 to enter into Executive Session regarding
            Abatements/Exemptions
The Board entered into executive session to review abatement and/or exemption applications pursuant
to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 59, Section 60, and Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7. We are 
meeting in executive session to comply with Chapter 59, Section 60, which limits inspection of Chapter 59 
abatement and exemption applications to assessors and the deputies, clerks and assistants of the assessors, and 
certain other parties listed in the law. Chapter 30A, Section 21, Item number 7 permits public bodies to meet in 
executive session for the purpose of complying with general laws. 
The Board of Assessors adjourned its open meeting at or about 5:40 p.m. 
Respectfully Submitted,
Linda Hicks, Assistant Assessor
